charts.title: Daily Review Count Trend
charts.description: This chart illustrates the daily number of LiveReview reviews completed within the 'hexmos-internal' organization, showing the trend of review activity over time.
charts.query_summary: Daily count of completed LiveReview reviews for hexmos-internal.
charts.sql:
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('day', COALESCE(reviews.completed_at, reviews.created_at)) AS day,
    COUNT(reviews.id) AS review_count
FROM
    reviews
WHERE
    reviews.org_id = {{.OrgID}}
GROUP BY
    DATE_TRUNC('day', COALESCE(reviews.completed_at, reviews.created_at))
ORDER BY
    DATE_TRUNC('day', COALESCE(reviews.completed_at, reviews.created_at));

charts.title: Cumulative LOC Reviewed Trend
charts.description: This chart displays the cumulative sum of billable lines of code reviewed by LiveReview members over time, indicating the overall growth in adoption and impact for 'hexmos-internal'.
charts.query_summary: Cumulative lines of code reviewed by members daily for hexmos-internal.
charts.sql:
SELECT
    daily_stats.day,
    SUM(daily_stats.daily_loc_reviewed) OVER (ORDER BY daily_stats.day) AS cumulative_loc_reviewed
FROM
    (
        SELECT
            DATE_TRUNC('day', loc_usage_ledger.created_at) AS day,
            SUM(loc_usage_ledger.billable_loc) AS daily_loc_reviewed
        FROM
            loc_usage_ledger
        WHERE
            loc_usage_ledger.org_id = {{.OrgID}}
            AND loc_usage_ledger.status = 'accounted'
            AND loc_usage_ledger.actor_kind = 'member'
        GROUP BY
            DATE_TRUNC('day', loc_usage_ledger.created_at)
    ) AS daily_stats
ORDER BY
    daily_stats.day;

charts.title: Engineer Review Activity Distribution
charts.description: This chart categorizes engineers by their total number of completed reviews, showing the breadth of adoption across the team.
charts.query_summary: Distribution of engineers by the number of completed reviews for hexmos-internal, categorized into adoption bands.
charts.sql:
WITH engineer_review_counts AS (
    SELECT reviews.user_email, COUNT(reviews.id) AS total_completed_reviews
    FROM reviews
    WHERE reviews.org_id = {{.OrgID}} AND reviews.user_email IS NOT NULL AND reviews.status = 'completed'
    GROUP BY reviews.user_email
)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN erc.total_completed_reviews = 0 THEN '0 reviews'
        WHEN erc.total_completed_reviews BETWEEN 1 AND 10 THEN '1-10 (light)'
        WHEN erc.total_completed_reviews BETWEEN 11 AND 20 THEN '11-20 (regular)'
        ELSE '21+ (heavy)'
    END AS review_band,
    COUNT(DISTINCT erc.user_email) AS engineer_count
FROM engineer_review_counts AS erc
GROUP BY
    CASE
        WHEN erc.total_completed_reviews = 0 THEN '0 reviews'
        WHEN erc.total_completed_reviews BETWEEN 1 AND 10 THEN '1-10 (light)'
        WHEN erc.total_completed_reviews BETWEEN 11 AND 20 THEN '11-20 (regular)'
        ELSE '21+ (heavy)'
    END
ORDER BY
    CASE
        WHEN CASE WHEN erc.total_completed_reviews = 0 THEN '0 reviews' WHEN erc.total_completed_reviews BETWEEN 1 AND 10 THEN '1-10 (light)' WHEN erc.total_completed_reviews BETWEEN 11 AND 20 THEN '11-20 (regular)' ELSE '21+ (heavy)' END = '0 reviews' THEN 0
        WHEN CASE WHEN erc.total_completed_reviews = 0 THEN '0 reviews' WHEN erc.total_completed_reviews BETWEEN 1 AND 10 THEN '1-10 (light)' WHEN erc.total_completed_reviews BETWEEN 11 AND 20 THEN '11-20 (regular)' ELSE '21+ (heavy)' END = '1-10 (light)' THEN 1
        WHEN CASE WHEN erc.total_completed_reviews = 0 THEN '0 reviews' WHEN erc.total_completed_reviews BETWEEN 1 AND 10 THEN '1-10 (light)' WHEN erc.total_completed_reviews BETWEEN 11 AND 20 THEN '11-20 (regular)' ELSE '21+ (heavy)' END = '11-20 (regular)' THEN 2
        ELSE 3
    END;

charts.title: Engineer Adoption Breadth
charts.description: This chart shows the distribution of engineers across different LiveReview adoption bands, from zero reviews to heavy usage, for the hexmos-internal organization. It indicates how many engineers are actively using LiveReview and at what intensity.
charts.query_summary: The distribution of engineers by their LiveReview usage intensity (number of completed reviews) for hexmos-internal.
charts.sql:
WITH engineer_review_counts AS (
    SELECT
        users.email AS engineer_email,
        COUNT(reviews.id) AS review_count
    FROM reviews
    JOIN users ON reviews.user_email = users.email
    WHERE reviews.org_id = {{.OrgID}} AND reviews.status = 'completed' AND reviews.user_email IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY users.email
),
all_org_members AS (
    SELECT users.email AS engineer_email
    FROM users
    JOIN user_roles ON user_roles.user_id = users.id AND user_roles.org_id = {{.OrgID}}
)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN erc.review_count IS NULL OR erc.review_count = 0 THEN '0 reviews'
        WHEN erc.review_count >= 1 AND erc.review_count <= 10 THEN '1-10 (light)'
        WHEN erc.review_count >= 11 AND erc.review_count <= 20 THEN '11-20 (regular)'
        WHEN erc.review_count >= 21 THEN '21+ (heavy)'
        ELSE 'Unknown'
    END AS adoption_band,
    COUNT(DISTINCT aom.engineer_email) AS engineer_count
FROM all_org_members AS aom
LEFT JOIN engineer_review_counts AS erc ON aom.engineer_email = erc.engineer_email
GROUP BY
    CASE
        WHEN erc.review_count IS NULL OR erc.review_count = 0 THEN '0 reviews'
        WHEN erc.review_count >= 1 AND erc.review_count <= 10 THEN '1-10 (light)'
        WHEN erc.review_count >= 11 AND erc.review_count <= 20 THEN '11-20 (regular)'
        WHEN erc.review_count >= 21 THEN '21+ (heavy)'
        ELSE 'Unknown'
    END
ORDER BY
    CASE
        WHEN CASE WHEN erc.review_count IS NULL OR erc.review_count = 0 THEN '0 reviews' WHEN erc.review_count >= 1 AND erc.review_count <= 10 THEN '1-10 (light)' WHEN erc.review_count >= 11 AND erc.review_count <= 20 THEN '11-20 (regular)' WHEN erc.review_count >= 21 THEN '21+ (heavy)' ELSE 'Unknown' END = '0 reviews' THEN 1
        WHEN CASE WHEN erc.review_count IS NULL OR erc.review_count = 0 THEN '0 reviews' WHEN erc.review_count >= 1 AND erc.review_count <= 10 THEN '1-10 (light)' WHEN erc.review_count >= 11 AND erc.review_count <= 20 THEN '11-20 (regular)' WHEN erc.review_count >= 21 THEN '21+ (heavy)' ELSE 'Unknown' END = '1-10 (light)' THEN 2
        WHEN CASE WHEN erc.review_count IS NULL OR erc.review_count = 0 THEN '0 reviews' WHEN erc.review_count >= 1 AND erc.review_count <= 10 THEN '1-10 (light)' WHEN erc.review_count >= 11 AND erc.review_count <= 20 THEN '11-20 (regular)' WHEN erc.review_count >= 21 THEN '21+ (heavy)' ELSE 'Unknown' END = '11-20 (regular)' THEN 3
        ELSE 4
    END;

charts.title: Active Engineers Over Time
charts.description: This chart shows the daily number of unique engineers who completed at least one review in the 'hexmos-internal' organization, indicating the trend of active users over time.
charts.query_summary: Daily count of active engineers in hexmos-internal.
charts.sql:
WITH daily_active_users AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('day', COALESCE(reviews.completed_at, reviews.created_at)) AS day,
        COUNT(DISTINCT reviews.user_email) AS active_users
    FROM
        reviews
    WHERE
        reviews.org_id = {{.OrgID}}
        AND reviews.status = 'completed'
        AND reviews.user_email IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY
        1
),
min_max_dates AS (
    SELECT
        MIN(day) AS min_date,
        MAX(day) AS max_date
    FROM
        daily_active_users
),
time_series AS (
    SELECT
        generate_series(mmd.min_date, mmd.max_date, '1 day'::interval) AS day
    FROM
        min_max_dates AS mmd
)
SELECT
    ts.day AS day,
    COALESCE(dau.active_users, 0) AS active_users_count
FROM
    time_series AS ts
LEFT JOIN
    daily_active_users AS dau ON ts.day = dau.day
ORDER BY
    ts.day;

charts.title: Repository Velocity Change
charts.description: This chart visualizes the change in lines of code reviewed for each repository, comparing the last 30 days to the previous 30 days. Repositories are colored based on whether they gained, lost, or had flat velocity.
charts.query_summary: Lines of code reviewed by repository for hexmos-internal, comparing the last 30 days to the previous 30 days.
charts.sql:
WITH RecentActivity AS (
    SELECT
        reviews.repository AS repository_name,
        loc_usage_ledger.billable_loc,
        COALESCE(reviews.completed_at, reviews.created_at) AS activity_time
    FROM
        loc_usage_ledger
    JOIN
        reviews ON loc_usage_ledger.review_id = reviews.id
    WHERE
        loc_usage_ledger.org_id = {{.OrgID}}
        AND loc_usage_ledger.status = 'accounted'
        AND loc_usage_ledger.operation_type = 'diff_review'
        AND reviews.user_email IS NOT NULL
        AND COALESCE(reviews.completed_at, reviews.created_at) >= NOW() - INTERVAL '60 days'
),
AggregatedPeriods AS (
    SELECT
        repository_name,
        SUM(CASE WHEN activity_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' THEN billable_loc ELSE 0 END) AS current_loc,
        SUM(CASE WHEN activity_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '60 days' AND activity_time < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' THEN billable_loc ELSE 0 END) AS previous_loc
    FROM
        RecentActivity
    GROUP BY
        repository_name
    HAVING
        SUM(billable_loc) > 0
)
SELECT
    ad.repository_name,
    'Current' AS period,
    ad.current_loc AS loc_reviewed,
    CASE
        WHEN ad.previous_loc = 0 AND ad.current_loc > 0 THEN 'gain'
        WHEN ad.current_loc > ad.previous_loc THEN 'gain'
        WHEN ad.current_loc < ad.previous_loc THEN 'loss'
        ELSE 'flat'
    END AS change_direction
FROM
    AggregatedPeriods ad
WHERE
    ad.current_loc > 0 OR ad.previous_loc > 0
UNION ALL
SELECT
    ad.repository_name,
    'Previous' AS period,
    ad.previous_loc AS loc_reviewed,
    CASE
        WHEN ad.previous_loc = 0 AND ad.current_loc > 0 THEN 'gain'
        WHEN ad.current_loc > ad.previous_loc THEN 'gain'
        WHEN ad.current_loc < ad.previous_loc THEN 'loss'
        ELSE 'flat'
    END AS change_direction
FROM
    AggregatedPeriods ad
WHERE
    ad.current_loc > 0 OR ad.previous_loc > 0
ORDER BY
    repository_name,
    period DESC;

charts.title: LOC Reviewed by Repository
charts.description: This chart shows the top 20 repositories by total lines of code reviewed in hexmos-internal, along with their cumulative percentage of the total.
charts.query_summary: Top 20 repositories by lines of code reviewed in hexmos-internal, showing cumulative percentage.
charts.sql:
SELECT
    reviews.repository AS repository_name,
    SUM(loc_usage_ledger.billable_loc) AS total_loc_reviewed,
    (SUM(SUM(loc_usage_ledger.billable_loc)) OVER (ORDER BY SUM(loc_usage_ledger.billable_loc) DESC)) * 100.0 / (SUM(SUM(loc_usage_ledger.billable_loc)) OVER ()) AS cumulative_pct
FROM
    loc_usage_ledger
JOIN
    reviews ON loc_usage_ledger.review_id = reviews.id
WHERE
    loc_usage_ledger.org_id = {{.OrgID}}
    AND loc_usage_ledger.status = 'accounted'
GROUP BY
    reviews.repository
ORDER BY
    total_loc_reviewed DESC
LIMIT 20;

charts.title: Daily LOC Reviewed Trend
charts.description: This chart shows the daily trend of lines of code reviewed by LiveReview for your top 5 repositories, indicating their velocity over time.
charts.query_summary: Daily lines of code reviewed by LiveReview for the top 5 repositories in hexmos-internal.
charts.sql:
WITH top_repositories AS (
    SELECT
        reviews.repository AS repository_name,
        SUM(loc_usage_ledger.billable_loc) AS total_loc_reviewed
    FROM
        loc_usage_ledger
    JOIN
        reviews ON loc_usage_ledger.review_id = reviews.id
    WHERE
        loc_usage_ledger.org_id = {{.OrgID}}
        AND reviews.org_id = {{.OrgID}}
        AND loc_usage_ledger.status = 'accounted'
        AND loc_usage_ledger.actor_kind = 'member'
    GROUP BY
        reviews.repository
    ORDER BY

)
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('day', loc_usage_ledger.created_at) AS day,
    reviews.repository AS repository_name,
    SUM(loc_usage_ledger.billable_loc) AS lines_of_code_reviewed
FROM
    loc_usage_ledger
JOIN
    reviews ON loc_usage_ledger.review_id = reviews.id
JOIN
    top_repositories ON reviews.repository = top_repositories.repository_name
WHERE
    loc_usage_ledger.org_id = {{.OrgID}}
    AND reviews.org_id = {{.OrgID}}
    AND loc_usage_ledger.status = 'accounted'
    AND loc_usage_ledger.actor_kind = 'member'

ORDER BY

charts.title: LOC Reviewed by Engineers (Pareto)
charts.description: This chart shows the top 20 engineers by total lines of code reviewed in the 'git-lrc' repository, along with the cumulative percentage of LOC they account for.
charts.query_summary: Top 20 engineers by total lines of code reviewed in the 'git-lrc' repository for hexmos-internal, with cumulative percentage.
charts.sql:
WITH EngineerLOC AS (
    SELECT
        users.first_name || ' ' || users.last_name AS engineer_name,
        SUM(loc_usage_ledger.billable_loc) AS total_loc_reviewed
    FROM loc_usage_ledger
    JOIN reviews ON loc_usage_ledger.review_id = reviews.id
    JOIN users ON loc_usage_ledger.user_id = users.id
    WHERE
        loc_usage_ledger.org_id = {{.OrgID}}
        AND loc_usage_ledger.status = 'accounted'
        AND loc_usage_ledger.operation_type = 'diff_review'
        AND reviews.repository ILIKE '%git-lrc%'
        AND loc_usage_ledger.user_id IS NOT NULL
        AND users.first_name IS NOT NULL
        AND users.last_name IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY
        loc_usage_ledger.user_id,
        users.first_name,
        users.last_name
)
SELECT
    engineer_name,
    total_loc_reviewed,
    ROUND(SUM(total_loc_reviewed) OVER (ORDER BY total_loc_reviewed DESC) * 100.0 / SUM(total_loc_reviewed) OVER (), 2) AS cumulative_pct
FROM EngineerLOC
ORDER BY
    total_loc_reviewed DESC
LIMIT 20;

charts.title: Top Repositories Reviewed by Each Engineer
charts.description: This chart displays the top 5 repositories each engineer has reviewed, indicating where their review activity is most concentrated.
charts.query_summary: This query identifies the top 5 repositories by review count for each engineer in hexmos-internal, based on completed reviews.
charts.sql:
WITH EngineerRepoReviews AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(users.first_name || ' ' || users.last_name, reviews.user_email) AS engineer_name,
        reviews.repository AS repository_name,
        COUNT(reviews.id) AS review_count
    FROM reviews
    JOIN users ON reviews.user_email = users.email
    JOIN user_roles ON users.id = user_roles.user_id AND user_roles.org_id = {{.OrgID}}
    WHERE
        reviews.org_id = {{.OrgID}}
        AND reviews.status = 'completed'
        AND reviews.user_email IS NOT NULL
        AND reviews.repository IS NOT NULL
        AND reviews.repository != ''
    GROUP BY
        COALESCE(users.first_name || ' ' || users.last_name, reviews.user_email),
        reviews.repository
),
RankedEngineerRepoReviews AS (
    SELECT
        engineer_name,
        repository_name,
        review_count,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY engineer_name ORDER BY review_count DESC) as rank_num
    FROM EngineerRepoReviews
)
SELECT
    engineer_name,
    repository_name,
    review_count
FROM RankedEngineerRepoReviews
WHERE rank_num <= 5
ORDER BY
    engineer_name, review_count DESC;

charts.title: Review Trigger Types per Engineer
charts.description: This chart shows the distribution of review trigger types (e.g., webhook, cli_diff, mcp) for each engineer, highlighting how they typically initiate reviews.
charts.query_summary: This query counts the number of completed reviews by each engineer in hexmos-internal, broken down by the type of trigger used to initiate the review.
charts.sql:
SELECT
    COALESCE(users.first_name || ' ' || users.last_name, reviews.user_email) AS engineer_name,
    reviews.trigger_type AS trigger_type,
    COUNT(reviews.id) AS review_count
FROM reviews
JOIN users ON reviews.user_email = users.email
JOIN user_roles ON users.id = user_roles.user_id AND user_roles.org_id = {{.OrgID}}
WHERE
    reviews.org_id = {{.OrgID}}
    AND reviews.status = 'completed'
    AND reviews.user_email IS NOT NULL
    AND reviews.trigger_type IS NOT NULL
    AND reviews.trigger_type != ''
GROUP BY
    COALESCE(users.first_name || ' ' || users.last_name, reviews.user_email),
    reviews.trigger_type
ORDER BY
    engineer_name, review_count DESC;

charts.title: Review Trigger Type Trends
charts.description: This chart shows the daily proportion of reviews by their trigger type (e.g., pre-commit, PR/MR), indicating shifts towards earlier review stages.
charts.query_summary: Daily trend of review trigger types and their percentage of total reviews for hexmos-internal.
charts.sql:
WITH daily_reviews AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('day', reviews.created_at) AS review_day,
        reviews.trigger_type AS trigger_type,
        COUNT(reviews.id) AS daily_review_count
    FROM
        reviews
    WHERE
        reviews.org_id = {{.OrgID}}
    GROUP BY
        1, 2
),
total_daily_reviews AS (
    SELECT
        review_day,
        SUM(daily_review_count) AS total_count_for_day
    FROM
        daily_reviews
    GROUP BY
        1
)
SELECT
    dr.review_day AS day,
    dr.trigger_type AS trigger_type,
    dr.daily_review_count AS review_count,
    ROUND((dr.daily_review_count * 100.0 / tdr.total_count_for_day), 2) AS percentage_of_total
FROM
    daily_reviews AS dr
JOIN
    total_daily_reviews AS tdr
ON
    dr.review_day = tdr.review_day
ORDER BY
    dr.review_day, dr.trigger_type;

charts.title: Average LOC Reviewed Trend
charts.description: This chart tracks the daily average lines of code reviewed per completed review, which can indicate if reviews are being performed on smaller (earlier) code changes over time.
charts.query_summary: Daily average lines of code reviewed per completed review for hexmos-internal.
charts.sql:
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('day', loc_usage_ledger.created_at) AS day,
    AVG(loc_usage_ledger.billable_loc) AS average_loc_per_review
FROM
    loc_usage_ledger
WHERE
    loc_usage_ledger.org_id = {{.OrgID}}
    AND loc_usage_ledger.status = 'accounted'
    AND loc_usage_ledger.operation_type = 'diff_review'
GROUP BY
    1
ORDER BY
    1;

charts.title: Proportion of Critical Issues by Trigger Type
charts.description: This chart displays the percentage of critical issues out of all issues found for each review trigger type. A higher percentage for 'cli_diff' (pre-commit) would indicate that serious issues are effectively being caught before PR/MR.
charts.query_summary: The percentage of critical issues found within each review trigger type ('cli_diff', 'webhook', 'mcp') for hexmos-internal.
charts.sql:
WITH issue_counts AS (
    SELECT
        reviews.trigger_type,
        comment_data ->> 'Severity' AS issue_severity,
        COUNT(*) AS severity_count
    FROM
        reviews,
        LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(reviews.metadata -> 'review_result' -> 'comments') AS comment_data
    WHERE
        reviews.org_id = {{.OrgID}}
        AND reviews.status = 'completed'
        AND jsonb_typeof(reviews.metadata -> 'review_result' -> 'comments') = 'array'
    GROUP BY
        reviews.trigger_type,
        issue_severity
),
total_issues_per_trigger_type AS (
    SELECT
        trigger_type,
        SUM(severity_count) AS total_issues
    FROM
        issue_counts
    GROUP BY
        trigger_type
)
SELECT
    ic.trigger_type,
    ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN ic.issue_severity = 'critical' THEN ic.severity_count ELSE 0 END)::numeric * 100 / tit.total_issues), 2) AS percentage_critical_issues
FROM
    issue_counts AS ic
JOIN
    total_issues_per_trigger_type AS tit ON ic.trigger_type = tit.trigger_type
WHERE
    tit.total_issues > 0
    AND ic.trigger_type IN ('cli_diff', 'webhook', 'mcp')
GROUP BY
    ic.trigger_type,
    tit.total_issues
ORDER BY
    percentage_critical_issues DESC;

charts.title: Daily Trend of Critical Issues by Trigger Type
charts.description: This chart shows the daily count of critical issues found by different review trigger types, specifically 'cli_diff' (pre-commit) and 'webhook' (PR/MR). This helps to visualize the trend of serious issues being caught over time.
charts.query_summary: The daily trend of critical issues found by review trigger types ('cli_diff', 'webhook', 'mcp') for hexmos-internal.
charts.sql:
WITH daily_critical_issues AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('day', COALESCE(reviews.completed_at, reviews.created_at)) AS review_day,
        reviews.trigger_type,
        COUNT(*) AS critical_issue_count
    FROM
        reviews,
        LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(reviews.metadata -> 'review_result' -> 'comments') AS comment_data
    WHERE
        reviews.org_id = {{.OrgID}}
        AND reviews.status = 'completed'
        AND jsonb_typeof(reviews.metadata -> 'review_result' -> 'comments') = 'array'
        AND comment_data ->> 'Severity' = 'critical'
        AND reviews.trigger_type IN ('cli_diff', 'webhook', 'mcp')
    GROUP BY
        review_day,
        reviews.trigger_type
),
all_days_and_trigger_types AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        gs.day AS review_day,
        t.trigger_type
    FROM
        GENERATE_SERIES(
            (SELECT MIN(DATE_TRUNC('day', COALESCE(completed_at, created_at))) FROM reviews WHERE org_id = {{.OrgID}}),
            (SELECT MAX(DATE_TRUNC('day', COALESCE(completed_at, created_at))) FROM reviews WHERE org_id = {{.OrgID}}),
            '1 day'::interval
        ) AS gs(day),
        (SELECT DISTINCT trigger_type FROM reviews WHERE org_id = {{.OrgID}} AND trigger_type IN ('cli_diff', 'webhook', 'mcp')) AS t
)
SELECT
    adt.review_day,
    adt.trigger_type,
    COALESCE(dci.critical_issue_count, 0) AS critical_issue_count
FROM
    all_days_and_trigger_types AS adt
LEFT JOIN
    daily_critical_issues AS dci ON adt.review_day = dci.review_day AND adt.trigger_type = dci.trigger_type
ORDER BY
    adt.review_day,
    adt.trigger_type;

charts.title: Top Problem Subcategories (Pareto)
charts.description: This Pareto chart identifies the top problem subcategories found in completed LiveReview comments for 'hexmos-internal' and shows their cumulative contribution to the total number of problems.
charts.query_summary: Top 20 problem subcategories by count and their cumulative percentage in completed LiveReview comments for hexmos-internal.
charts.sql:
WITH subcategory_counts AS (
    SELECT
        comment_data->>'Subcategory' AS comment_subcategory,
        COUNT(*) AS subcategory_count
    FROM
        reviews,
        LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(reviews.metadata->'review_result'->'comments') AS comment_data
    WHERE
        reviews.org_id = {{.OrgID}}
        AND reviews.status = 'completed'
        AND jsonb_typeof(reviews.metadata->'review_result'->'comments') = 'array'
        AND comment_data->>'Subcategory' IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY
        comment_subcategory
)
SELECT
    comment_subcategory,
    subcategory_count,
    ROUND(SUM(subcategory_count) OVER (ORDER BY subcategory_count DESC) * 100.0 / SUM(subcategory_count) OVER (), 2) AS cumulative_pct
FROM
    subcategory_counts
ORDER BY
    subcategory_count DESC
LIMIT 20;

charts.sql:
SELECT
    reviews.repository AS repository_name,
    COUNT(comments.value) AS issue_count,
    ROUND(SUM(COUNT(comments.value)) OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(comments.value) DESC) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(comments.value)) OVER (), 2) AS cumulative_pct
FROM

CROSS JOIN LATERAL
    jsonb_array_elements(reviews.metadata->'review_result'->'comments') AS comments
WHERE
    reviews.org_id = {{.OrgID}}
    AND reviews.status = 'completed'
    AND jsonb_typeof(reviews.metadata->'review_result'->'comments') = 'array'
GROUP BY
    reviews.repository
ORDER BY

LIMIT 20;

charts.title: Daily LiveReview Cost
charts.description: This chart shows the total daily cost incurred by LiveReview for all code review operations.
charts.query_summary: Daily total cost of LiveReview operations for hexmos-internal.
charts.sql:
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('day', quota_operation_aggregates.finalized_at) AS day,
    SUM(quota_operation_aggregates.total_cost_usd_total) AS total_cost
FROM quota_operation_aggregates
WHERE
    quota_operation_aggregates.org_id = {{.OrgID}}
    AND quota_operation_aggregates.operation_type = 'diff_review'
    AND quota_operation_aggregates.finalized_at IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

charts.title: Daily Cost per Line of Code
charts.description: This chart illustrates the daily cost efficiency of LiveReview, showing the cost per line of code reviewed.
charts.query_summary: Daily cost per line of code reviewed by LiveReview for hexmos-internal.
charts.sql:
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('day', quota_operation_aggregates.finalized_at) AS day,
    SUM(quota_operation_aggregates.total_cost_usd_total) AS total_cost,
    SUM(quota_operation_aggregates.effective_loc_total) AS effective_loc,
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(quota_operation_aggregates.effective_loc_total) > 0
        THEN ROUND(CAST(SUM(quota_operation_aggregates.total_cost_usd_total) / SUM(quota_operation_aggregates.effective_loc_total) AS numeric), 6)
        ELSE 0
    END AS cost_per_loc
FROM quota_operation_aggregates
WHERE
    quota_operation_aggregates.org_id = {{.OrgID}}
    AND quota_operation_aggregates.operation_type = 'diff_review'
    AND quota_operation_aggregates.finalized_at IS NOT NULL
    AND quota_operation_aggregates.effective_loc_total > 0
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

charts.title: Median Review Duration Trend
charts.description: This chart shows the daily median time taken for reviews to reach completion, helping to identify if reviews are getting faster or slower over time across your organization.
charts.query_summary: Daily median review duration for hexmos-internal.
charts.sql:
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('day', reviews.completed_at) AS day,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (reviews.completed_at - reviews.started_at)) / 60.0) AS median_review_duration_minutes
FROM
    reviews
WHERE
    reviews.org_id = {{.OrgID}}
    AND reviews.status = 'completed'
    AND reviews.started_at IS NOT NULL
    AND reviews.completed_at IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
    day
ORDER BY
    day;

charts.query_summary: Daily median review duration for hexmos-internal, broken down by trigger type.
charts.sql:
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('day', reviews.completed_at) AS day,
    reviews.trigger_type AS trigger_type,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (reviews.completed_at - reviews.started_at)) / 60.0) AS median_review_duration_minutes
FROM
    reviews
WHERE
    reviews.org_id = {{.OrgID}}
    AND reviews.status = 'completed'
    AND reviews.started_at IS NOT NULL
    AND reviews.completed_at IS NOT NULL

    reviews.trigger_type
ORDER BY

    reviews.trigger_type;

charts.title: Top Repositories by Lines of Code Reviewed
charts.description: This chart shows the top 20 repositories by total lines of code reviewed, along with a cumulative percentage line to highlight the concentration of work in 'hexmos-internal'.
charts.query_summary: Top 20 repositories by lines of code reviewed for hexmos-internal, showing cumulative percentage.
charts.sql:
WITH RepositoryLOC AS (
    SELECT
        reviews.repository AS repository_name,
        SUM(loc_usage_ledger.billable_loc) AS loc_reviewed
    FROM
        loc_usage_ledger
    JOIN
        reviews ON loc_usage_ledger.review_id = reviews.id
    WHERE
        loc_usage_ledger.org_id = {{.OrgID}}
        AND reviews.org_id = {{.OrgID}}
        AND loc_usage_ledger.status = 'accounted'

)
SELECT
    repository_name,
    loc_reviewed,
    SUM(loc_reviewed) OVER (ORDER BY loc_reviewed DESC) * 100.0 / SUM(loc_reviewed) OVER () AS cumulative_percentage
FROM
    RepositoryLOC
ORDER BY
    loc_reviewed DESC
LIMIT 20;

charts.title: Engineer Review Activity Bands
charts.description: This chart shows the distribution of LiveReview activity across all engineers, categorizing them into bands based on the number of completed reviews.
charts.query_summary: Distribution of engineers into review activity bands (0, 1-10, 11-20, 21+ reviews) for hexmos-internal.
charts.sql:
WITH engineer_review_counts AS (
    SELECT
        ur.user_id,
        COALESCE(COUNT(r.id), 0) AS review_count
    FROM
        user_roles AS ur
    INNER JOIN
        users ON ur.user_id = users.id
    LEFT JOIN
        reviews AS r ON ur.user_id = users.id AND r.user_email = users.email AND r.org_id = {{.OrgID}} AND r.status = 'completed'
    WHERE
        ur.org_id = {{.OrgID}}
    GROUP BY
        ur.user_id
),
engineer_bands AS (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN review_count = 0 THEN '0 reviews'
            WHEN review_count BETWEEN 1 AND 10 THEN '1-10 (light)'
            WHEN review_count BETWEEN 11 AND 20 THEN '11-20 (regular)'
            ELSE '21+ (heavy)'
        END AS review_band,
        user_id
    FROM
        engineer_review_counts
)
SELECT
    review_band,
    COUNT(user_id) AS engineer_count
FROM
    engineer_bands
GROUP BY
    review_band
ORDER BY
    CASE review_band
        WHEN '0 reviews' THEN 1
        WHEN '1-10 (light)' THEN 2
        WHEN '11-20 (regular)' THEN 3
        WHEN '21+ (heavy)' THEN 4
    END;

charts.title: Overall Feedback Distribution
charts.description: This chart shows the overall proportion of upvotes versus downvotes received on LiveReview comments across your organization.
charts.query_summary: The distribution of upvotes and downvotes for LiveReview comments in hexmos-internal.
charts.sql:
SELECT
    review_feedback.vote_type,
    COUNT(review_feedback.id) AS vote_count
FROM
    review_feedback
WHERE
    review_feedback.org_id = {{.OrgID}} AND review_feedback.vote_type IN ('up', 'down')
GROUP BY
    review_feedback.vote_type
ORDER BY
    vote_count DESC;

charts.title: Upvote and Downvote Trend Over Time
charts.description: This chart illustrates the daily trend of upvotes and downvotes received on LiveReview comments.
charts.query_summary: The daily trend of upvotes and downvotes for LiveReview comments in hexmos-internal.
charts.sql:
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('day', review_feedback.created_at) AS day,
    review_feedback.vote_type,
    COUNT(review_feedback.id) AS vote_count
FROM
    review_feedback
WHERE
    review_feedback.org_id = {{.OrgID}} AND review_feedback.vote_type IN ('up', 'down')
GROUP BY
    DATE_TRUNC('day', review_feedback.created_at),
    review_feedback.vote_type
ORDER BY
    day,
    review_feedback.vote_type;

charts.title: Feedback by Review Category
charts.description: This chart breaks down the net sentiment (upvotes vs. downvotes) for different categories of review comments, highlighting which types of feedback are most trusted or disputed.
charts.query_summary: The upvotes and downvotes for each review comment category in hexmos-internal.
charts.sql:
SELECT
    comment_element->>'Category' AS review_category,
    review_feedback.vote_type,
    CASE
        WHEN review_feedback.vote_type = 'up' THEN COUNT(review_feedback.id)
        WHEN review_feedback.vote_type = 'down' THEN -COUNT(review_feedback.id)
        ELSE 0
    END AS signed_vote_count
FROM
    review_feedback
JOIN
    reviews ON review_feedback.review_id = reviews.id
CROSS JOIN LATERAL
    jsonb_array_elements(reviews.metadata->'review_result'->'comments') AS comment_element
WHERE
    reviews.org_id = {{.OrgID}}
    AND review_feedback.org_id = {{.OrgID}}
    AND review_feedback.vote_type IN ('up', 'down')
    AND jsonb_typeof(reviews.metadata->'review_result'->'comments') = 'array'
    AND comment_element->>'Category' IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
    comment_element->>'Category',
    review_feedback.vote_type
HAVING
    COUNT(review_feedback.id) > 0
ORDER BY
    review_category,
    review_feedback.vote_type;

charts.title: Daily Review Activity Trend
charts.description: This chart shows the daily count of completed reviews, indicating the overall engagement and consistency of the review workflow over time.
charts.query_summary: Analyzes the daily trend of completed reviews for hexmos-internal.
charts.sql:
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('day', reviews.created_at) AS review_day,
    COUNT(reviews.id) AS review_count
FROM
    reviews
WHERE
    reviews.org_id = {{.OrgID}}
    AND reviews.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY
    DATE_TRUNC('day', reviews.created_at)
ORDER BY
    review_day;

charts.title: Engineer Review LOC Contribution (Pareto)
charts.description: This chart identifies the top engineers by lines of code reviewed and shows the cumulative percentage of total LOC reviewed they account for, highlighting contribution concentration.
charts.query_summary: Shows the top 20 engineers by lines of code reviewed and their cumulative contribution to the total for hexmos-internal.
charts.sql:
WITH EngineerLoc AS (
    SELECT
        users.email AS engineer_email,
        SUM(loc_usage_ledger.billable_loc) AS total_loc_reviewed
    FROM
        loc_usage_ledger
    JOIN
        users ON loc_usage_ledger.user_id = users.id
    JOIN
        user_roles ON users.id = user_roles.user_id AND user_roles.org_id = {{.OrgID}}
    WHERE
        loc_usage_ledger.org_id = {{.OrgID}}
        AND loc_usage_ledger.operation_type = 'diff_review'
        AND loc_usage_ledger.status = 'accounted'
        AND loc_usage_ledger.actor_kind = 'member'
    GROUP BY
        users.email
)
SELECT
    engineer_email,
    total_loc_reviewed,
    ROUND(SUM(total_loc_reviewed) OVER (ORDER BY total_loc_reviewed DESC) * 100.0 / SUM(total_loc_reviewed) OVER (), 2) AS cumulative_pct
FROM
    EngineerLoc
WHERE
    total_loc_reviewed > 0
ORDER BY
    total_loc_reviewed DESC
LIMIT 20;

charts.title: Distribution of Review Issue Severities
charts.description: This chart shows the proportion of identified issues categorized by their severity level (e.g., critical, warning, info), highlighting the types of problems LiveReview is catching.
charts.query_summary: Breaks down the count of issues by their severity level found in completed reviews for hexmos-internal.
charts.sql:
SELECT
    comment_obj ->> 'Severity' AS comment_severity,
    COUNT(*) AS issue_count
FROM
    reviews,
    LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(reviews.metadata -> 'review_result' -> 'comments') AS comment_obj
WHERE
    reviews.org_id = {{.OrgID}}
    AND reviews.status = 'completed'
    AND jsonb_typeof(reviews.metadata -> 'review_result' -> 'comments') = 'array'
    AND comment_obj ->> 'Severity' IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
    comment_severity
ORDER BY
    issue_count DESC;

charts.title: Review Trigger Type Distribution
charts.description: This chart illustrates how reviews are initiated within your organization (e.g., via webhook, CLI, or MCP), providing insight into the adoption of different review mechanisms.
charts.query_summary: Shows the distribution of review trigger types for completed reviews within hexmos-internal.
charts.sql:
SELECT
    reviews.trigger_type,
    COUNT(reviews.id) AS review_count
FROM
    reviews
WHERE
    reviews.org_id = {{.OrgID}}
    AND reviews.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY
    reviews.trigger_type
ORDER BY
    review_count DESC;

charts.title: Review Count Change by Engineer
charts.description: This chart visualizes the change in the number of completed reviews for each engineer between the week before last and the most recent complete week. Lines sloping upwards indicate a gain in review count, downwards indicate a loss, and flat lines indicate no change.
charts.query_summary: Shows how the number of completed reviews by each engineer in hexmos-internal changed between the week before last and the most recent complete week.
charts.sql:
WITH time_periods AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('week', NOW() - INTERVAL '1 week') AS current_week_start,
        DATE_TRUNC('week', NOW() - INTERVAL '2 weeks') AS previous_week_start
),
current_week_reviews AS (
    SELECT
        reviews.user_email,
        COUNT(reviews.id) AS review_count
    FROM
        reviews
    WHERE
        reviews.org_id = {{.OrgID}}
        AND reviews.status = 'completed'
        AND COALESCE(reviews.completed_at, reviews.created_at) >= (SELECT current_week_start FROM time_periods)
        AND COALESCE(reviews.completed_at, reviews.created_at) < (SELECT current_week_start FROM time_periods) + INTERVAL '1 week'
        AND reviews.user_email IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY
        reviews.user_email
),
previous_week_reviews AS (
    SELECT
        reviews.user_email,
        COUNT(reviews.id) AS review_count
    FROM
        reviews
    WHERE
        reviews.org_id = {{.OrgID}}
        AND reviews.status = 'completed'
        AND COALESCE(reviews.completed_at, reviews.created_at) >= (SELECT previous_week_start FROM time_periods)
        AND COALESCE(reviews.completed_at, reviews.created_at) < (SELECT previous_week_start FROM time_periods) + INTERVAL '1 week'
        AND reviews.user_email IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY
        reviews.user_email
),
combined_reviews AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(c.user_email, p.user_email) AS user_email,
        COALESCE(c.review_count, 0) AS current_week_review_count,
        COALESCE(p.review_count, 0) AS previous_week_review_count
    FROM
        current_week_reviews c
    FULL OUTER JOIN
        previous_week_reviews p ON c.user_email = p.user_email
    WHERE
        COALESCE(c.review_count, 0) > 0 OR COALESCE(p.review_count, 0) > 0
),
users_in_org AS (
    SELECT
        users.email,
        CONCAT_WS(' ', users.first_name, users.last_name) AS engineer_name
    FROM
        users
    JOIN
        user_roles ON user_roles.user_id = users.id AND user_roles.org_id = {{.OrgID}}
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(u.engineer_name, cr.user_email) AS engineer_name,
    cr.previous_week_review_count AS previous_week_review_count,
    cr.current_week_review_count AS current_week_review_count,
    'Previous Week' AS period_label,
    cr.previous_week_review_count AS review_count,
    CASE
        WHEN cr.current_week_review_count > cr.previous_week_review_count THEN 'gain'
        WHEN cr.current_week_review_count < cr.previous_week_review_count THEN 'loss'
        ELSE 'flat'
    END AS change_direction
FROM
    combined_reviews cr
LEFT JOIN
    users_in_org u ON cr.user_email = u.email
UNION ALL
SELECT
    COALESCE(u.engineer_name, cr.user_email) AS engineer_name,
    cr.previous_week_review_count AS previous_week_review_count,
    cr.current_week_review_count AS current_week_review_count,
    'Current Week' AS period_label,
    cr.current_week_review_count AS review_count,
    CASE
        WHEN cr.current_week_review_count > cr.previous_week_review_count THEN 'gain'
        WHEN cr.current_week_review_count < cr.previous_week_review_count THEN 'loss'
        ELSE 'flat'
    END AS change_direction
FROM
    combined_reviews cr
LEFT JOIN
    users_in_org u ON cr.user_email = u.email
ORDER BY
    engineer_name, period_label;

charts.title: Lines of Code Reviewed Change by Engineer
charts.description: This chart illustrates the change in the total lines of code reviewed by each engineer between the week before last and the most recent complete week. Upward slopes indicate an increase in LOC reviewed, downward slopes indicate a decrease, and flat lines indicate no change.
charts.query_summary: Shows how the total lines of code reviewed by each engineer in hexmos-internal changed between the week before last and the most recent complete week.
charts.sql:
WITH time_periods AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('week', NOW() - INTERVAL '1 week') AS current_week_start,
        DATE_TRUNC('week', NOW() - INTERVAL '2 weeks') AS previous_week_start
),
current_week_loc AS (
    SELECT
        loc_usage_ledger.user_id,
        SUM(loc_usage_ledger.billable_loc) AS loc_reviewed_count
    FROM
        loc_usage_ledger
    WHERE
        loc_usage_ledger.org_id = {{.OrgID}}
        AND loc_usage_ledger.status = 'accounted'
        AND loc_usage_ledger.operation_type = 'diff_review'
        AND loc_usage_ledger.accounted_at >= (SELECT current_week_start FROM time_periods)
        AND loc_usage_ledger.accounted_at < (SELECT current_week_start FROM time_periods) + INTERVAL '1 week'
        AND loc_usage_ledger.user_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY
        loc_usage_ledger.user_id
),
previous_week_loc AS (
    SELECT
        loc_usage_ledger.user_id,
        SUM(loc_usage_ledger.billable_loc) AS loc_reviewed_count
    FROM
        loc_usage_ledger
    WHERE
        loc_usage_ledger.org_id = {{.OrgID}}
        AND loc_usage_ledger.status = 'accounted'
        AND loc_usage_ledger.operation_type = 'diff_review'
        AND loc_usage_ledger.accounted_at >= (SELECT previous_week_start FROM time_periods)
        AND loc_usage_ledger.accounted_at < (SELECT previous_week_start FROM time_periods) + INTERVAL '1 week'
        AND loc_usage_ledger.user_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY
        loc_usage_ledger.user_id
),
combined_loc AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(c.user_id, p.user_id) AS user_id,
        COALESCE(c.loc_reviewed_count, 0) AS current_week_loc_reviewed,
        COALESCE(p.loc_reviewed_count, 0) AS previous_week_loc_reviewed
    FROM
        current_week_loc c
    FULL OUTER JOIN
        previous_week_loc p ON c.user_id = p.user_id
    WHERE
        COALESCE(c.loc_reviewed_count, 0) > 0 OR COALESCE(p.loc_reviewed_count, 0) > 0
),
users_in_org AS (
    SELECT
        users.id AS user_id,
        CONCAT_WS(' ', users.first_name, users.last_name) AS engineer_name,
        users.email
    FROM
        users
    JOIN
        user_roles ON user_roles.user_id = users.id AND user_roles.org_id = {{.OrgID}}
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(u.engineer_name, u.email) AS engineer_name,
    cl.previous_week_loc_reviewed AS previous_week_loc_reviewed,
    cl.current_week_loc_reviewed AS current_week_loc_reviewed,
    'Previous Week' AS period_label,
    cl.previous_week_loc_reviewed AS loc_reviewed_count,
    CASE
        WHEN cl.current_week_loc_reviewed > cl.previous_week_loc_reviewed THEN 'gain'
        WHEN cl.current_week_loc_reviewed < cl.previous_week_loc_reviewed THEN 'loss'
        ELSE 'flat'
    END AS change_direction
FROM
    combined_loc cl
LEFT JOIN
    users_in_org u ON cl.user_id = u.user_id
ORDER BY
    engineer_name, period_label;
